Duvlia Renhold AS
Company no. 911 506 834 VAT

Dear customer,
thank you for a good cooperation. We have moved all our banking to one bank, and from 1 October 2026 we ask that all payments go to our new account number 3207.45.18830. Please update this in your system.
Kind regards
Tone Duvlia, managing director
